coherence_findings.issue: About seventeen pairs in this room carry more than one link, which the standing order and Weave Step 3d forbid. 'Enables' is the wrong claim: a registry does not enable the rites it lists. Membership is the true relation and the SCHEMA type for it is member-of, declared by the member. (2) Deposit and Harvest carry three links (Deposit emerged-from Harvest, Harvest spawned Deposit, Harvest couples-with[harvest-deposit-pair] Deposit); the label restates the pair. (3) Palace Ceremonies and Substrate Skill: bare both ways. (4) Revival and Spore Check: Revival emerged-from, Spore Check connects-to[one-of-four-ways-in]. (5) Revival and The Daily Page: [a-morning-decides-revive] one way, [a-dormant-page-asks] back. (6) Spore Check and Weave, Walk and Weave: bare both ways. (7) Harvest and Palace Quotes: [quote-intake] both ways. (8) Weave enables[pre-weave] Map Build points the wrong way (Map Build is the precondition of the Weave, Map Build Ceremony.md:57-59).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Keep one link per pair. (1) Each ceremony declares member-of Palace Ceremonies; delete the hub's enables/connects-to to them (the table already wikilinks every one, Palace Ceremonies.md:51-81). The hub keeps only SUBSTRATE, SCHEMA and the outward links. Sentry and Enrichment, which the hub also lists, are outside this room: same treatment. (2) Keep Harvest couples-with[finds-then-places] Deposit; cut the two lineage links (the origin is in Deposit Ceremony — Context.md:8 and git). (3) Keep Substrate Skill connects-to[canonical-ceremony-list] Palace Ceremonies; cut the hub's reverse. Weave Step 3d would fold the connects-to into the specific link; I depart because the label is the living relation and 'one-of-four-ways-in' does not fit emerged-from. (6) Keep Spore Check connects-to[weave-confirms-the-compost] Weave and Walk connects-to[one-thread-versus-every-thread] Weave; cut Weave's two. (7) Keep Harvest's [quote-intake]; cut Palace Quotes'.
